title: Robot Barista Coffee Mat Configurator
description: Users configure a robotic barista station by positioning a robot behind a coffee mat serving counter. The task involves scaling, rotating, and color-customizing both assets, setting an animation sequence where the robot slides toward the coffee mat, and validating all parameters before exporting a final product snapshot.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Robot Barista Station Configurator. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: shared_assets/robot.glb and shared_assets/coffeemat.glb. Place the coffee mat on a ground plane at the origin and position the robot behind it offset on the Z axis. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 6) looking at the origin. Add ambient light intensity 0.6, a directional light from (5, 8, 5) with intensity 1.0 casting shadows, and a soft hemisphere light. Enable renderer shadows. Create an HTML control panel overlay on the right side with these interactions: (1) A range slider to uniformly scale the robot from 0.5 to 2.0 with a default of 1.0 and a numeric display. (2) A range slider to rotate the robot on the Y axis from 0 to 360 degrees. (3) A color picker that applies a tint to the robot by traversing its meshes and setting material color. (4) A range slider to scale the coffee mat from 0.5 to 3.0 with default 1.0. (5) A dropdown to select one of four mat surface finishes: matte, glossy, metallic, or rough, adjusting the material roughness and metalness accordingly. (6) A button labeled 'Animate Serve' that triggers a smooth tween animation over 1.5 seconds moving the robot forward toward the coffee mat and back using requestAnimationFrame and lerp. (7) A 'Validate & Export' button that checks all parameters are within valid ranges, the robot scale is not equal to the mat scale, and the robot Y rotation is not zero, then displays a green confirmation message or red error text listing which validations failed. All sliders must show their current numeric value. The ground plane should be a subtle grid-textured plane with receiveShadow enabled. Add a subtle environment background color of 0xf0ece4.
